records.name: Culture & Psychology
records.scope_notes: Cultural meaning-making, qualitative evidence, theory, methodological work and synthesis. The journal explicitly prioritizes qualitative/theoretical approaches and says it does not publish standard quantitative manuscripts. Ordinary quantitative behavioral analysis without the required cultural theoretical approach is unsuitable. Sage requires disclosure of generative AI and prohibits specified uses, including producing a submission through successive prompts and analysing experiences/themes; ordinary assistive editing has a disclosure exemption.
